name: infomaniak-mcp-server
description: Drive your Infomaniak account from Claude: hosting, domains, DNS, kDrive, mail and AI Tools.
long_description: MCP server wrapping the Infomaniak public API. Exposes 40+ tools so Claude can list/manage Web Hosting plans, sites, FTP and MySQL databases, domains and DNS records, kDrive files, Mail Hosting mailboxes and aliases, and AI Tools chat completions. Destructive operations (delete_*, create_order) require an explicit confirm=true flag. Authenticates with a Personal API Token created at https://manager.infomaniak.com.

api_token.title: Infomaniak API Token
api_token.description: Personal API Token created at https://manager.infomaniak.com → API Token Manager. Scope it to the products you want Claude to manage.

api_base_url.title: API base URL (optional)
api_base_url.description: Override the Infomaniak API base URL. Leave empty to use https://api.infomaniak.com.

ai_product_id.title: Default AI Tools product UUID (optional)
ai_product_id.description: Default product_id used by infomaniak_ai_chat / infomaniak_ai_list_models when none is supplied at call time.
